messages.author: 2ed19a7addb843f5
messages.subject: Force output to reactivate
parts:
I have sort of a weird application in which the output depends on the input but is non-deterministic. I would like the user to be able to re-generate the output with a submit button. I've implement this for the most part, except this doesn't work when the input doesn't change (since my output is a reactiveTable and thus won't re-run unless the input changes).

Is there a way to force re-generation of output based on button click without input changing? I would also settle with clearing the input to force the user to enter new input.

My code isn't worth posting... just a ui.R with a textInput and a server.R with a renderTable().

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: Force output to reactivate
parts:
You can use an actionButton, similar to this example:
  http://glimmer.rstudio.com/winston/actionbutton/
  https://gist.github.com/wch/4963887

It sounds like you'll want to do one thing differently, though. In this example, the isolate() function is used so that it _only_ updates when button is clicked, but I think you don't want to use it in your case. (Assuming you want it to update if the input value is changed OR the button is clicked.)

More information on the code is here, as well as an explanation of isolate():
  http://rstudio.github.com/shiny/tutorial/#isolation

-Winston
